expected.description: export-sarif's refusal of a pull request whose trusted comment was edited by another login has no test (deleting it keeps t.py green), nor do the block-head, control-character path and drive-letter checks.
Two distinct findings with the same file, dimension and normalized claim at different lines get the same primaryLocationLineHash, so GitHub treats them as one result.
export-sarif copies only failure_scenario into the SARIF properties, but real reports write scenario:, so every real failure scenario is dropped.
